units.source_text: 源氏公子举目四顾，但见帷屏后面、纸隔扇旁边，以及各处空地方，聚集着侍女约三十人。

en.t: Prince Genji raised his eyes and looked around, and saw about thirty waiting women gathered behind the curtains and screens, beside the paper sliding doors, and in every open space.

units.source_text: 她们都穿着黑色丧服，有的深黑，有的浅黑，个个愁容满面，神色沮丧，样子非常可怜。

en.t: They were all dressed in black mourning clothes, some deep black and some lighter black, and every one of them wore a sorrowful, dejected look that was deeply pitiable.

units.source_text: 左大臣看了，对源氏公子说：“我女儿虽然死了，但你所舍不得的小公子留在这里，今后你便中决不会不来看视。

en.t: Seeing this, the Minister of the Left said to Prince Genji, "Though my daughter has died, the young lord whom you cannot bear to leave remains here, so surely you will not fail to come and look after him from now on.
We all take comfort in that.

units.source_text: 然而这些冥顽无知的侍女，都以为你将从此抛舍这个旧家，今后不再回顾。

en.t: Yet these ignorant, uncomprehending waiting women all think that from now on you will abandon this old household and never look back again.

units.source_text: 她们现在倒不是为死别而伤心，却是为了今后不得再像从前那样时时侍奉左右而悲叹。

en.t: What grieves them now is not so much the parting caused by death, but the thought that they will no longer be able to serve at your side as constantly as before.

units.source_text: 往日你俩不能融洽相处，我却常常指望你们将来言归于好，不道已成空花泡影！

en.t: In the past the two of you could not live together harmoniously, but I always hoped that someday you would be reconciled; I never imagined it would all become an empty dream!

units.source_text: 唉，今天的暮色好不凄凉呵！”说罢又淌下泪来。

en.t: Ah, how desolate this evening light is today!" When he had said this, tears flowed down again.
